bridge_purpose: Tie player principal, permissions/admin, command response, and commands/replies planning docs to one fail-closed vocabulary before any public ABI.

shared_principal_vocabulary.required_meaning: principal_handle is an opaque copied principal value only; it is never sufficient by itself to authorize permissions, command dispatch, response targeting, lookup, persistence, mutation, or return override
principal_generation is the generation/invalidation discriminator required with principal_handle except for a separately reviewed callback-local-only contract
principal_scope_flags is the explicit scope discriminator for callback-local, process-local, or separately promoted wider scope; unsupported or mismatched scope fails closed

required_bridge_behaviors: principal_handle, principal_generation, and principal_scope_flags must appear together in any future command, permission, or response payload that consumes player identity
permissions/admin cannot return allow from command text, operator config, plugin input, or missing runtime principal observation
command/chat response targeting cannot create principal or permission claims
commands/replies cannot dispatch when permission result is deny or unknown
commands/replies cannot imply replies, send-chat, broadcast, moderation, storage, or admin mutation
missing or zero plugin_owner_token fails closed for every future owner-token bridge operation
missing capability fails closed and no capability bit is reserved by this bridge
legacy CallProcessEvent debug access is not a command, reply, response, permission, or principal bridge
ArkServerApi, ArkApi, AseApi, and NextGenPlugins names may inform demand only and cannot provide offsets, layouts, vtables, code, control flow, or ABI semantics
forbidden_public_contract: principal or permission claims from command text
principal or permission claims from operator config
non_claims: This bridge does not add public header symbols.
This bridge does not reserve public capability bits.
This bridge does not define a response ABI.
This bridge does not promote player identity, permissions/admin, command/chat response path, or commands/replies.
This bridge does not authorize runtime wiring, server validation, live probes, public command routing, replies, send-chat, moderation, admin mutation, storage, lookup, mutation, or return override.
This bridge is a planning-only fail-closed vocabulary guardrail.
